content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler multiple vegetables, Stage 3 is a ready‑to‑serve puree blend of several vegetables designed for children from 12 months old. The blend contains carrot, broccoli, cauliflower, sweet potato and peas, steamed and finely pureed without added salt, sugar or preservatives.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend was developed by pediatricians and nutritionists to provide a varied diet during the transition from single‑vegetable purees to more complex meals.
All vegetables are grown without GMOs or synthetic pesticides.
The product undergoes gentle heat treatment that retains most B‑vitamins and carotenoids.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and ensures a long shelf life without preservatives.
The puree can be used as a base for first meals with meat or fish, making it easy to create balanced dishes.

items.title: Rich in beta‑carotene
items.content: Sweet potato and carrot provide provitamin A, which supports vision and immune function.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: Broccoli and cauliflower supply vitamin C, helping strengthen the immune system and improve iron absorption.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Peas and the vegetables overall promote healthy digestion and a balanced gut microbiome.

items.title: Supports brain development
items.content: Folate found in broccoli and peas is essential for the growth of neural cells in young children.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: No added salt makes the product safe for a child's developing kidneys.

items.title: Vegetable allergy
items.content: Some children may be allergic to one of the ingredients (e.g., peas). Introduce a small amount first and observe for reactions.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Although the puree is smooth, ensure the child does not try to swallow large lumps if the puree is thinned with liquid.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Broccoli and cauliflower contain low levels of oxalates; the current formula keeps them minimal.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The puree is ready to eat straight from the pack. It can be gently warmed to body temperature, mixed with breast milk, formula or water to adjust consistency, and used as a base for first meals with meat, fish or grains.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pack in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 7 days. Discard if the package is damaged or the smell changes.
